signals.rationale: The woman nods her head affirmatively and smiles warmly while the off-screen speaker repeats the name, indicating her assent.
The woman maintains steady eye contact with the speaker off-screen, tilting her head slightly and smiling attentively as she listens.
The speaker maintains steady eye contact and an upright posture while delivering his statement. His voice is clear and steady, and he speaks fluently without any filler words or hesitation.
